title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Dominicus, VI Īd. Nov. (Sun 8 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra 3–21° and sunny; the RBA's fifth rate rise (4.85%, an 18-year high) and Angus Taylor: 'homegrown' inflation; US midterms: Republicans lose both houses, Stephen Miller new chief of staff, Hegseth under fire; Iran's offer via Qatar, tankers hit mines in Hormuz; Karl Bushby home after 28 years on foot; Opīniō: Judith Sloan on Labor's $560m grants; Nerva born, AD 30. English headlines, Latin, then the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (4 Nov); The Spectator Australia; Yahoo News (6 Nov); Times of Israel (6 Nov); ITV News (2 Nov).
lines: Salvēte, audītōrēs. Haec sunt Ācta Diurna.
Hodiē est diēs Dominicus, ante diem sextum Īdūs Novembrēs.
Prīmum tempestās. Deinde rēs Austrāliae. Deinde orbis terrārum.
Tum rēs laeta, opīniō, et hodiē in historiā.
The weather. Canberra first: a sunny Sunday, cold morning, warm afternoon.
Māne frīgidum est: trēs gradūs tantum.
Post merīdiem calidum est: ūnus et vīgintī gradūs.
Ventus māne flat, circā merīdiem cadit.
Crās, diē Lūnae, caelum iterum serēnum erit.
Crās calidius erit: quīnque et vīgintī gradūs.
Ergō: hodiē ūnus et vīgintī gradūs, crās quīnque et vīgintī.
Canberrae hodiē caelum serēnum, māne frīgidum, post merīdiem calidum.
Sydnēiae fortasse imber est. Ūnus et vīgintī gradūs.
Melburnī sōl lūcet. Duo et vīgintī gradūs.
Brisbanae caelum partim nūbilum est. Ūndētrīgintā gradūs.
Perthī sōl lūcet. Quattuor et vīgintī gradūs.
Adelaidiae sōl lūcet. Quattuor et vīgintī gradūs.
Hobartī caelum partim nūbilum est. Ūndēvīgintī gradūs.
Paene ubīque in Austrāliā sōl lūcet.
Australia. The Reserve Bank has raised interest rates again: the fifth rise this year, the highest rate in eighteen years.
Argentāria centrālis Austrāliae faenus iterum auxit.
Hoc est quīntum incrēmentum hōc annō.
Faenus nunc est quattuor et octōgintā quīnque centēsimae per centum.
Faenus nunc paene quīnque per centum est.
Faenus tam altum nōn fuit ab annō bis mīllēsimō octāvō.
Duodēvīgintī annōs faenus tam altum nōn fuit.
Inflātiō nunc est quattuor et trēs decimae per centum.
Bullock dīcit: in Austrāliā nimis multī nimis multa emunt.
Et cīvēs et rēs pūblica nimis multum impendunt.
The Opposition Leader, Angus Taylor, says the government is in denial.
Taylor dīcit prīmum ministrum et aerārī ministrum rem negāre.
Taylor dīcit: haec inflātiō domestica est.
Taylor putat: haec inflātiō nōn ex orbe terrārum venit, sed ex Austrāliā ipsā.
Taylor putat: rēs pūblica nimis multum impendit.
Coalitiō ūnum et trīgintā mīlliarda dollarōrum servāre vult.
Coalitiō pecūniam prō climate et prō domibus minuere vult.
The Prime Minister blames the world: oil prices. The Finance Minister points to the war in the Middle East.
Albanese autem dīcit: nōn nostra culpa est.
Albanese dīcit causās ex orbe terrārum venīre.
Minister fīnantiārum dīcit: causa est bellum in Oriente Mediō.
Mēnse Decembrī rēs pūblica novās ratiōnēs prōpōnet.
Tum vidēbimus: minuetne rēs pūblica impēnsās?
Interim faenus altum est, et mūtua cārissima sunt.
Quī domum ēmit, nunc plūs solvit.
Faenus altum, pretia alta, mūtua cāra.
The world. In the United States, the Republicans have lost both houses of Congress in the midterm elections.
Dēmocratae et senātum et Domum Repraesentantium obtinuērunt.
In Domō Repraesentantium Dēmocratae plūs quam ducentās quīnquāgintā sēdēs habent.
In senātū Dēmocratae quīnquāgintā quattuor sēdēs habent.
Duae sēdēs adhūc incertae sunt: in Alaskā et in Mississippiā.
In Alaskā Maria Peltola paucīs suffrāgiīs superat.
Paucīs suffrāgiīs: sescentīs trīgintā septem tantum.
In Mississippiā Scott Colom paucīs suffrāgiīs superat.
After the defeat, a shake-up in the White House: Stephen Miller is the new chief of staff.
Post clādem Trump aulam suam mūtat.
Susie Wiles aulam Albae Domūs regēbat.
Nunc Stephanus Miller aulam Albae Domūs reget.
And the Defence Secretary, Pete Hegseth, is under pressure. Trump stands by him.
Thomas Massie, Rēpūblicānus, Hegseth accūsāre vult, nisi Hegseth discēdit.
Hegseth dīcit: hoc nōn valuit contrā Trump, nec valēbit contrā mē.
The war with Iran. Iran is reported to have sent a new nuclear proposal through Qatar. Trump says: nothing without our approval.
Īrānia novam condiciōnem dē rē nucleārī mīsisse dīcitur.
Qataria inter Americānōs et Īrāniam mediātrīx est.
Trump dīcit: nihil faciunt sine nostrā approbātiōne.
Trump dīcit: mālim reliquam Īrāniam nōn dēlēre. Sed fortasse dēlēre dēbēbō.
Īrānia dīcit duās nāvēs oleāriās in fretō Hormuziānō ārsisse.
Īrānia dīcit nāvēs viā vetitā nāvigāvisse.
Emir Qatariae Trump rogāvit nē bellum augēret.
Et Turcia foedus cum Arabiā Saudiānā et Pakistāniā cōnfirmāvit.
Propter hoc bellum pretium oleī altum est.
Et propter pretium oleī, pretia etiam in Austrāliā crēscunt, ut Albanese dīcit.
Something good. A British man has walked home after twenty-eight years: around the world, on foot.
Annō mīllēsimō nōngentēsimō nōnāgēsimō octāvō iter incēpit.
Iter incēpit in Chīliā, in urbe Punta Arenas.
Domum ambulāre voluit. Pedibus. Sine nāve, sine currū.
Annō bis mīllēsimō prīmō silvās Dariēnis trānsiit.
In Panamā duodēvīgintī diēs in carcere fuit.
Annō bis mīllēsimō sextō per glaciem fretī Bering iter fēcit.
Deinde in Russiā in carcere fuit, quia sine permissū vēnerat.
Multa impedīmenta fuērunt: pecūnia dēfuit, deinde morbus per orbem terrārum.
Nunc, post duodētrīgintā annōs, domum vēnit.
Bushby dīxit: nōn vīcus, sed tōtus orbis terrārum mē hūc dūxit.
Duodētrīgintā annōs ambulāvit, et nunc domī est.
Opinion. This is the view of the economist Judith Sloan, in The Spectator Australia: Labor's grants are a vote-buying scheme.
Haec est sententia Iūdithae Sloan, in Spectātōre Austrāliānō.
Rēs pūblica quīngentōs sexāgintā mīliōnēs dollarōrum dat.
Pecūniam dat prō piscīnīs, prō aedificiīs commūnibus, prō clubīs golfī.
Sloan dīcit: haec est ēmptiō suffrāgiōrum.
Pecūnia praesertim in sēdēs Labōris it.
Sex mīliōnēs dollarōrum clubō golfī Marrickvillae datī sunt.
Marrickville in sēde prīmī ministrī est.
Ōlim Bridget Mackenzie propter parvam pecūniam discessit.
Nunc sex mīliōnēs dantur, et nēmō discēdit.
Sloan dīcit: hoc nōn est opus reī pūblicae Canberrae.
Cīvitātēs, urbēs, et ipsī clubī haec solvere dēbent.
Et Sloan addit: ambae partēs pecūniā pūblicā sīc abūtuntur.
On this day, in the year thirty, the emperor Nerva was born.
Hodiē, annō trīcēsimō post Chrīstum nātum, Nerva nātus est.
Annō nōnāgēsimō sextō imperātor factus est.
Domitiānus occīsus erat. Senātus Nervam lēgit.
Nerva senex erat: sexāgintā quīnque annōs nātus.
Fīlium nōn habēbat. Itaque Trāiānum adoptāvit.
Sed bonum successōrem lēgit. Hoc est magnum.
Mārcus et Lūcius, ut semper, aderant. Sed id alia fābula est.
Canberrae caelum serēnum est. Ūnus et vīgintī gradūs.
Crās calidius erit: quīnque et vīgintī gradūs.

In Americā Rēpūblicānī graviter victī sunt.

Stephanus Miller nunc aulam Albae Domūs reget.
